feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 19 July 2026 4:14pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 19 July 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the west of Ireland will continue to extend a ridge eastwards across Britain.


##Wind##

Mainly north or northwest 2 to 4, occasionally 5 in the northwest of the area at first, then becoming 4 or 5 in all waters later this evening and overnight and touching force 6 in the northwest of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the west.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest 3 to 5, perhaps 6 towards the northwest of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
